summary: Backend verification of CopperKnob scrub / step_sheet normalization migration. All 12 pytest assertions passed. GET /api/dances returns 507 dances; 0 dances mention 'copperknob' (case-insensitive) or 'copperknob.co.uk'; every dance has non-empty choreographer and song; Stompin' Ground retains Erin Boroughs credit, DJ Jamin credit, and movement summary with no dangling 'Official step sheet:' line; 354 dances use the canonical clean placeholder (matches expected ~350). Grep of /app/backend/seed_dances.py, seed_dances_v2.py, seed_dances_v3_run.py, seed_dances_v4_run.py confirmed 0 occurrences of 'copperknob'/'CopperKnob'.

Only /app/backend/scrub_copperknob.py still contains the 'copperknob' string (as an intentional filter/regex target). All seed source files are clean, so a fresh re-seed will not reintroduce the reference.
